messages:
Jordan: quick UX flag from working on the routing sim: when you enable simulated traffic the preview spinner covers the conflict badge and keyboard users can't reach the reorder handle. noticed on firefox.
Priya: yikes. does the spinner sit on a higher z-index than the toolbar? can you screenshot?
Jordan: yep it's z-index: 999 and positioned over the left rail. screenshot attached. also the sim toggle tooltip copy says "simulate traffic" which is fine but not clear it will temporarily disable reorders.
Maya: ok two problems: visual overlap + misleading copy. proposal: move spinner into the preview footer, not the rail, and change tooltip copy to "Simulate traffic (disables reordering while running)".
Sam: implementation note: spinner currently blocks pointer events with overlay; we can change overlay to allow pointer-events: none for the rail area but still prevent interactions inside the preview. might be fragile. better to move spinner like Maya suggested.
Jordan: accessibility: when sim starts we should announce status via aria-live and also set aria-disabled on the reorder handles so screen readers know reordering is temporarily disabled.
Priya: agree. for keyboard users we should also skip the handles in tab order while simulating. aria-hidden or tabindex=-1? prefer toggling tabindex to -1 so focusable elements don't shift unexpectedly.
Maya: copy tweak idea for the inline banner after sim completes: "Simulation complete  Results may highlight priority conflicts. Review preview to confirm routing." is a bit long. shorter: "Simulation complete  Check preview for conflicts."
Sam: small dev question: how long does sim run by default? if it's short we can keep the toast ephemeral, otherwise persistent. current default is 8s but users can extend.
Jordan: default we set to 8s. i'd vote persistent for any sim >3s. people might be tabbing around and miss transient toasts.
Priya: sounds good. Maya, can you mock the moved spinner + banner + updated tooltip copy? Jordan, can you file the a11y tasks? Sam, can you estimate the change (spinner move + tabindex toggle + aria-live)?
Maya: yes, mock in ~3 hours. will try both dark and light theme contrasts.
Jordan: created UX task UX-4189 and added checklist: - move spinner (todo), - aria-live announce on start/end (todo), - toggle tabindex for reorder handles (todo), - update tooltip + finish copy (done).
DesignBot: Accessibility checklist updated for UX-4189: 
- Ensure spinner relocation does not reduce contrast or hide content (todo)
- Use aria-live polite/assertive depending on context (todo)
- Maintain logical tab order when handles are disabled (todo)
DesignBot: Linked UX-4189 to board lane "Routing editor improvements".
Priya: thanks everyone. adding to next sprint grooming.
